summary:
Plot 0 follows the roof-height map: a 141-high pale limestone slab (with a penthouse to y 148) stepping down 132/105/59 toward Fifth Avenue, and a six-storey U podium plus Fifth Ave wings with roof gardens on setback decks at y 26. A stepped Deco portal frames the open forecourt where bronze ATLAS kneels under a 9-ring copper armillary sphere, between granite pylons. Atlas's real spot is in the notch at x 72..83, which is off the footprint, so the forecourt is pushed back to x 63..71 where the map shows a low 17-18 block. The British Empire Building and La Maison Française are identical six-storey twins with deeper setback storeys, gardened roofs and gilded relief panels over their Fifth Ave doors. Continuous piers, dark window strips, ~25% lit windows and floodlit setback decks make it read as Rockefeller Center from the air at dusk. Pale-buff limestone Art Deco ensemble in the architect's frames: stepped tower with floodlit penthouse, Fifth Ave wings with roof gardens, a portal framing the forecourt with bronze ATLAS under a copper armillary sphere, and the twin 6-storey Channel Gardens buildings.
Six parts: massing shell, portal and forecourt, Atlas, facades and lit fittings, roofs, gardens and lighting, final check. Dusk is carried by ~25% lit bays, lit shopfronts and lobby, and froglight-lit decks and crowns.

parts.name: massing shell
parts.scope: All masses in the architect's table with decks, parapets and plinth, for plot 0 then plots 1 and 2 (same module); leave every opening and reserved cell as air. Uses pier_strip_face geometry only for the wall bodies.

parts.name: portal and forecourt
parts.scope: E portal x58..62 z20..35 y2..18 (portal_bay), forecourt paving x63..71 (y1, joints every 3), granite pylons (pylon), Atlas plinth (plinth), lobby ceiling y16.

parts.name: Atlas and armillary sphere
parts.scope: atlas_figure kneeling on the plinth (x65..69 z25..30 y6..15), ring_circle, ring_ellipse and ring_tilted sphere centred (67,16,27.5), axis with lightning_rod stubs, and uplights.

parts.name: facades and fittings
parts.scope: pier_strip_face on all faces, lit_bay at ~25%, shop_bay with fascia and name boards (plaque), bronze_door, deco_panel and emblem on the portal and on plot 1/2 east ends, crown_band.

parts.name: roofs, gardens and lighting
parts.scope: smooth_stone decks, copings, deck_light per the ROOFS table, penthouse crown froglights, roof_garden on GN, GS and GB, ledge_planter, lamp_post, vent. No dark deck cell.

parts.name: final check
parts.scope: Run $MCD check and light checks, fix floating blocks, dark cells, unconnected panes and anything over the height limits.

recruit.why: limestone piers, quoins, portal and cornice, and a plinth in worked stone
cast-bronze Atlas and a hollow armillary sphere of crossing rings
recessed window strips, shopfront glass, doors in bronze frames, Deco panels
shop fascia name boards and the heraldic emblems
roof gardens, ledge hedges and trees
dusk lighting of lobbies, windows, crowns, decks, uplights
